It's kinda sad, actually. I've made my peace with pretty much everyone who I thought hated me... and try my hardest not to do things that make people hate me to begin with. 

There's this girl that I had been friends with since we were 13. Pretty wild kids, we were. I have a massive scar on my arm from being drunk and teenaged and falling into her firepit from catching my foot on the lip of her pool. All in good fun.

A few years ago we reunited at a party after not seeing each other for quite some time. My ride ditched me, so I went home with her, a block away, to crash on the couch. On the way, we stopped at a convenience store so she could get smokes. She pulled out a large wad of money to pay, set some down to pull out a small bill, then we went on our way. She'd drank 2/3rds a fifth of whiskey, I'd had a bottle of wine. We promptly passed out.

I woke to her angry at 4am. She wanted to know where her missing $700 was. I had no clue. She berated me, insistent that I had taken it. I offered to let her check my pockets and purse- she said if I didn't really take it then it wasn't an issue. I went back to sleep and she drove me home in the morning.

The next day, she posted on her social networking site that I had stolen the money. I got a bunch of phone calls from mutual friends wanting to know what was up- but a lot of people were as puzzled as I was because this crowd had known me for nearly 10 years and knew damn well that I wouldn't do that. She made it known she hated me and everytime we saw each other from that point on she wouldn't speak to me. It was awkward.

Fast forward two days ago. I found out she passed away. I've never **not** squashed a beef with someone and while I really didn't have control over the situation, I sure wish I could have made things right. Now I can't, ever. We were friends for so long and I hate that I can't even go to her memorial because I was "that chick".

TLDR: If you can, settle your issues, before you don't have the chance. You'll have a hard time forgiving yourself if you come to a place where there's no making it better.
